title: The canonical stalk of an etale scheme over a trait
statement: Let R be a domain discrete valuation ring, f:X→Spec R an etale morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and x∈X with f(x)=m_R. Let varpi generate m_R. For the actual stalk A=O_(X,x) and the canonical structural map delta:R→A, given by R→O_(Spec R,f(x))→O_(X,x), A is a domain DVR, delta is injective, and m_A=(delta(varpi)). No section or affine etale chart is assumed.

proof.text: The closed-point stalk isomorphism identifies the base stalk with R. A DVR is integrally closed of dimension one, so the existing IsRegularLocalRing.of_isIntegrallyClosed theorem makes this base regular. Etaleness implies the source is locally of finite type over the Noetherian spectrum, hence its stalk A is Noetherian.

Apply Flat.stalkMap and the local-hom instance to the canonical stalk map. Faithful flatness gives injectivity. FormallyUnramified.map_maximalIdeal_stalkMap identifies the image of the base maximal ideal with the target maximal ideal. The existing proved theorem IsRegularLocalRing.of_flat_of_map_maximalIdeal_eq gives regularity of A; the regular-local-domain instance gives IsDomain A.

Transport the maximal ideal along the closed-point stalk isomorphism and map its singleton generator through the stalk map. The resulting generator is nonzero by injectivity and nonzero uniformizer in R. Thus A cannot be a field. The principal-maximal-ideal condition of IsDiscreteValuationRing.TFAE gives the DVR instance. All ring data are the explicit stalk and canonical structural homomorphism.

proof_origin.source: Lean reduction of the local argument in Stacks Tags 0AP2 and 0EYI using existing regular-local and unramified-stalk theorems

lean.statement:
theorem etale_trait_stalk (R : CommRingCat.{u})
    [IsDomain R] [IsDiscreteValuationRing R]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec R) [Etale f] (x : X)
    (hx : f x = IsLocalRing.closedPoint R)
    (ϖ : R) (hϖ : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span {ϖ}) :
    ∃ (_ : IsDomain (X.presheaf.stalk x))
      (_ : IsDiscreteValuationRing (X.presheaf.stalk x)),
      Function.Injective (StructureSheaf.toStalk R (f x) ≫ f.stalkMap x).hom ∧
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x) =
        Ideal.span {(StructureSheaf.toStalk R (f x) ≫ f.stalkMap x).hom ϖ}
